hints: Set up the conditions for equilibrium of coplanar forces: $\Sigma F_x = 0$ and $\Sigma F_y = 0$.
Express $T_B$ in terms of $T_A$, substitute into the vertical equation, and solve for both tensions.
walkthrough:
State the conditions for the static equilibrium of the particle under coplanar forces:
$$\sum F_x = 0\quad\text{and}\quad\sum F_y = 0$$

Resolve forces horizontally (taking the rightward direction towards $B$ as positive):
$$T_B\cos 40^\circ - T_A\cos 35^\circ = 0$$
$$T_B = T_A\frac{\cos 35^\circ}{\cos 40^\circ}\quad \text{(Equation 1)}$$

Resolve forces vertically (taking upwards as positive):
$$T_A\sin 35^\circ + T_B\sin 40^\circ - mg = 0$$
$$T_A\sin 35^\circ + T_B\sin 40^\circ = (2.4)(10) = 24\text{ N}\quad \text{(Equation 2)}$$

Substitute Equation 1 into Equation 2 to eliminate $T_B$:
$$T_A\sin 35^\circ + T_A\left(\frac{\cos 35^\circ}{\cos 40^\circ}\right)\sin 40^\circ = 24$$
$$T_A\left(\sin 35^\circ + \cos 35^\circ\tan 40^\circ\right) = 24$$

Solve for $T_A$:
$$T_A = \frac{24}{1.260926} \approx 19.0336\text{ N}$$
$$T_A = 19.0\text{ N}\quad (\text{to 3 significant figures})$$

Substitute $T_A \approx 19.0336\text{ N}$ into Equation 1 to find $T_B$:
$$T_B = 19.0336 \times \frac{\cos 35^\circ}{\cos 40^\circ} = 19.0336 \times \frac{0.819152}{0.766044} \approx 20.3532\text{ N}$$
$$T_B = 20.4\text{ N}\quad (\text{to 3 significant figures})$$
